Why are the 100k Chase Ink Cash/Unlimited still listed here in November if they expired in September?

DP – I was targeted for Ink Cash while I already have Ink Unlimited since last year. “You’re pre -approved!” type verbiage with a link to click through on my account homepage. Went through the process, was put into pending on Friday, and Saturday night received secure message I was denied due to already “having or had” an Ink no annual fee CC.

So if you already have an acctive no annual fee Chase Ink Cash or Unlimited, don’t apply for the other no AF Ink card.

I have one US Bank and two Chase Ink Business Unlimited cards (one sole prop, one LLC). I bonused on US Bank and the first Chase card, and getting close to the bonus on my second.

Now that I can look closer, my current Chase Sapphire Preferred $750 for $5k spend offer is for my new Chase personal account I just opened. I’m not sure if I’ll pursue it since it’s a personal card, and I still don’t understand all these rules and different cards here lol. I opened my second Chase Business Unlimited for the LLC without too much thought given to all these caveats and rules.

Which biz cards do you have? I wasn’t targeted in my personal account but I did have the Chase INK Cash at $1,200 offer in my biz account. Fred’s comment about it possibly going higher gave me pause. Lol

Datapoint: On my account overview page, I have the green “You’re Already Approved” flag appearing on several cards; one is the Chase Ink Preferred 100K (The only Ink card I have is the Ink Cash).

I was still denied – too many recently opened accounts. I’m currently at 4/24…which probably overrides the “Already Approved” link. Meanwhile, the green banners are still on my Chase home page…Very deceptive!
